body:
The SIGNAL button's 3-step RGY chat flow was only 2/3 implemented: `showRoomChat` state was set on room selection but no component existed to render it, silently swallowing the interaction. ## Root cause `handleRoomSelect` set `showRoomChat = true` and `selectedRoom`, but `FullscreenApp` had no JSX block conditional on `showRoomChat`, and `RGYRoomView` was never built. ## Changes - **`src/components/RGYRoomView.tsx`** _(new)_ ΓÇö Chat room view implementing the rgynext reference design: 4 display modes (List, Card, Grid, Map), anonymous CQ-XXXX capsule messages, Enter-to-send input, back navigation to room list. - **`src/components/FullscreenApp.tsx`** ΓÇö Adds the missing import and render block: ```tsx {showRoomChat && selectedRoom && selectedChatColor && (
...
)} ``` Pattern is consistent with the existing `showColorSelector` and `showRoomList` blocks above it. The complete flow now works end-to-end: ``` SIGNAL tap ΓåÆ RGYColorSelector ΓåÆ RGYIntentKeywordList ΓåÆ RGYRoomView ``` --- ≡ƒöÆ GitHub Advanced Security automatically protects Copilot coding agent pull requests. You can protect all pull requests by enabling Advanced Security for your repositories. [Learn more about Advanced Security.](https://gh.io/cca-advanced-security)
title: Fix: RGY SIGNAL button ΓÇö wire missing Step 3 (RoomView) to complete chat flow
